_about: One case list for both crisis lexicons: backend/chat/policy-router.js (PATTERNS.crisis, read by backend/tests/crisis-lexicon-parity.test.js) and frontend/src/chat/crisis-lexicon.js (read by frontend/src/chat/crisis-lexicon-parity.test.js). 'crisis' must be a crisis statement on both sides. 'topic' names suicide, self-harm or overdose as a topic: not a crisis statement, but answered with the resource footer. 'not_crisis' is neither. Typographic apostrophes are written as \u2019 on purpose.
